# ui::testing

Namespace-scope declarations of `ui::testing` from the testing headers.

## Functions

### clear_dirty

```cpp
void clear_dirty(Element& element, DirtyFlags flags = DirtyFlags::All)
```

Header: `winui/testing/ElementAccess.hpp`.

Clears `flags` on `element` and its subtree, as the window does after drawing a frame, so a test can then check what a change marks dirty.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::ButtonControl button{"Save"};
ui::testing::clear_dirty(button);
button.set_text("Save all");
REQUIRE(button.is_dirty(ui::DirtyFlags::Layout));
```

### set_focused

```cpp
void set_focused(Element& element, bool focused)
```

Header: `winui/testing/ElementAccess.hpp`.

Shows `element` focused or not, as its window does when keyboard focus arrives or leaves, for a test that drives a control on its own.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::TextBoxControl box;
ui::testing::set_focused(box, true);
box.handle_key(ui::KeyEvent{.key = ui::Key::End});
```

### set_focus_visible

```cpp
void set_focus_visible(Element& element, bool visible)
```

Header: `winui/testing/ElementAccess.hpp`.

Sets `element`'s focus-visible state, as its window does when the input modality changes.

### render_with_focus_ring

```cpp
void render_with_focus_ring(const Element& element, Renderer& renderer, const Theme& theme = Theme::default_light())
```

Header: `winui/testing/ElementAccess.hpp`.

Draws `element` as its window draws the root of a tree, for a test that checks a focus ring without a [Window](../tree/window.md). It draws the element, then the focus ring of the focused, focus-visible element inside it on top of everything.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::ButtonControl button{"Save"};
// ... measure and arrange it ...
ui::testing::set_focused(button, true);
ui::testing::TestRenderer renderer;
ui::testing::render_with_focus_ring(button, renderer);
```

### set_clipboard

```cpp
void set_clipboard(Clipboard* clipboard)
```

Header: `winui/testing/TestClipboard.hpp`.

Makes [ui::clipboard()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#clipboard) return [`clipboard`](../tree/namespace-ui.md#clipboard) for the whole process, so every control copies to and pastes from it; nullptr goes back to the platform's. Non-owning: [`clipboard`](../tree/namespace-ui.md#clipboard) must stay alive while installed (a [TestClipboard](test-clipboard.md) uninstalls itself when destroyed).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::testing::TestClipboard clipboard;
ui::testing::set_clipboard(&clipboard);
clipboard.set_text("Portland");

auto box = std::make_unique<ui::TextBoxControl>();
ui::testing::set_focused(*box, true);
box->handle_key({ui::Key::V, ui::KeyAction::Down, {.ctrl = true}});
REQUIRE(box->text() == "Portland");
```

### set_jump_list_host

```cpp
void set_jump_list_host(JumpListHost* host)
```

Header: `winui/testing/TestJumpListHost.hpp`.

Makes [ui::set_jump_list()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#set_jump_list) and [ui::add_recent_file()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#add_recent_file) use `host` for the whole process; nullptr goes back to the platform's. Non-owning: `host` must stay alive while installed (a [TestJumpListHost](test-jump-list-host.md) uninstalls itself when destroyed).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::testing::TestJumpListHost jump_list;
ui::testing::set_jump_list_host(&jump_list);
ui::set_jump_list({});
REQUIRE(jump_list.set_count == 1);
```

### set_launcher

```cpp
void set_launcher(Launcher* launcher)
```

Header: `winui/testing/TestLauncher.hpp`.

Makes [ui::launch_uri()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#launch_uri), [ui::launch_file()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#launch_file) and the controls that open links use `launcher` for the whole process; nullptr goes back to the platform's. Non-owning: `launcher` must stay alive while installed (a [TestLauncher](test-launcher.md) uninstalls itself when destroyed).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::testing::TestLauncher launcher;
ui::testing::set_launcher(&launcher);
ui::launch_uri("https://example.com");
REQUIRE(launcher.launched == std::vector<std::string>{"https://example.com"});
```


Header: `winui/testing/TestMessageBoxHost.hpp`.

Makes [ui::message_box()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#message_box) use `host` for the whole process; nullptr goes back to the platform's. Non-owning: `host` must stay alive while installed (a [TestMessageBoxHost](test-message-box-host.md) uninstalls itself when destroyed).

### describe

```cpp
std::string describe(const Window& window)
```

Header: `winui/testing/TestRenderer.hpp`.

Renders `window` through a [TestRenderer](test-renderer.md) and prints the result with [ui::describe()](../rendering/namespace-ui.md#describe): the semantic golden of a whole window. Lay the window out first; the dump starts with the theme's [SetRasterization](../rendering/render-commands.md#struct-setrasterization) line.

Example: 
```cpp
// What the window draws right now, as text, to diff against an earlier frame.
const std::string frame = ui::testing::describe(window);
std::println("{}", frame);
```
